The {{PAGENAME}} is located northwest of The Village close to the wheat farm selling apiary products. From the [[Dead Horse]], head west and then north towards the [[Woodcutter]], and their house will be the second to the left, opposite of [[Rosa]].

As the [[bee]]s drop rate from wild hives is fairly low and {{Item|bee|10}} are needed to start a {{Item|Bee hive}} of your own, one may need to purchase some bees from this vendor at some point.
